text:
deploy-bot: promo hold: staging canary failed - artifact restore 504s + cache restore throttle causing runner init hang. blocking change window.
emma: saw smoke fail, pod stuck at Init:RestoreArtifacts then timed out mounting.
rick: paste from runner logs: "fetch blob attempt=3 status=504" then "restore queue backing up -> mount wait exceeded 2m"
ci-bot: job 5012 logs:
``
2026-04-05T14:03:12Z ERROR restore: blob fetch failed status=504 attempt=3
2026-04-05T14:05:13Z ERROR init: mount timeout after 120s
```
emma: we also saw a spike in cache-get latency in the artifact proxy metrics (p95 -> 4s -> 12s). probably both contributed.
infra-oncall: checking registry and cache tier. artifact-registry shows increased 5xxs from 14:02-14:06, cache layer throttling at 14:04. looks like a brief surge.
rick: options: (1) manual pin to last-successful image and promote, (2) rerun canary after infra clears, (3) postpone promotion. change window tight.
emma: rerun risks same failure. prefer pin+promote then follow up with canary rerun after infra fix.
infra-oncall: can clear cache throttle by increasing backend pool for ~15m; can do immediately but it will take ~10-15m to fully clear backlog.
deploy-bot: ready to apply manual pin if approved. which image sha?
emma: pin to sha256:9f1d2a (from prod-promote-2026-04-04). add release note: "Canary pinned during change window after transient artifact proxy 5xx spike and cache throttle; infra investigating."
rick: also add action to mute automatic canary retries for 30m to avoid thundering.
infra-oncall: starting cache-pool scale up, monitoring artifact-registry. ETA 12m.
deploy-bot: applying pin to release v2.8.0 -> sha256:9f1d2a, suspending canary retries, proceeding with promote for pinned image. action id: 7743219999-pin-1.
ci-bot: manual promote pipeline started for pinned image, smoke checks queued.
emma: noted in changelog and release notes. follow-up ticket created: RLS-2026-421.
infra-oncall: update: backend pool scaled, artifact 5xxs subsided at 14:18, cache latency returning to normal. will advise when backlog cleared.
rick: decision record: pin+promote to meet change window; will rerun canary once artifact backlog cleared and unpin if safe.
deploy-bot: release log updated.
